name: CHARM
description: A benchmark for evaluating the commonsense reasoning ability of large language models in Chinese, covering both globally known and Chinese-specific commonsense, with interconnected reasoning and memorization tasks.
reputation: A newer Chinese commonsense benchmark that has been cited as a useful testbed for culturally grounded reasoning, but it is not yet as widely adopted as major English commonsense suites.
notes: Evaluates both reasoning and memorization abilities; includes analysis of prompt strategies and error types; first comprehensive Chinese commonsense reasoning benchmark.
